title: Tool crib checkout log
summary: A copyable checkout log with an overdue item, a return, and a quarantine.

blocks.heading: Know who has it, and whether it can go back on the shelf
blocks.body: Fictional entries show one row per loan. Copy the blank format into your shared log. This page is a template: cells are not editable and checks are not saved.

blocks.heading: At the 14:00 handoff
blocks.caption: Names, jobs and events are invented. Calibration status comes from the controlled equipment record, not this example.

blocks.heading: Close the loop
items: At issue, confirm identity, condition, accessories, calibration status and a real due time.
At return, compare against the issue record and record the receiving person and time.
Damage or suspected accuracy loss goes to quarantine. A return timestamp alone does not make a tool available again.
